name: Interdimensional Gift Shop
description: A tourist trap that exists in all dimensions simultaneously, maximizing its ability to sell overpriced souvenirs. Shelves contain: 'I Survived the Reality Collapse' t-shirts (premature), snowglobes with impossible geometries, postcards from dimensions that don't exist, and those little spoons collectors love. A rack of sunglasses promises to let you 'See Through Time!' (They're just regular sunglasses.) Everything is 20% off, except reality, which is 100% off.
